outcome: Knowledge of essential home care needs
Knowledge of sexual and reproductive healthcare needs
cohort: The study involved 467 randomly selected post-cesarean section mothers in Central Tanzania.
finding: Generally, the knowledge of home care after cesarean section births among postpartum mothers in Central Tanzania is inadequate, particularly regarding sexual and reproductive healthcare.
mod_finding: Post-cesarean section mothers with only one prior cesarean section were less likely to possess adequate knowledge about essential healthcare needs and sexual and reproductive healthcare.
